from pathlib import Path
import requests,json,hashlib,re
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
root=Path.cwd(); out=root/'reports/research/510300_fed_reserve_three_cause_weekly_score_v1'
url='https://www.federalreserve.gov/releases/h41/default.htm'
receipt={'url':url,'attempt_number':2,'prior_attempt':'上一轮第一次 requests 请求因 TLS UNEXPECTED_EOF_WHILE_READING 失败；未写来源或模型结果。','tls_verify':True,'requested_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()}
try:
    r=requests.get(url,timeout=40,headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)'})
    receipt.update(http_status=r.status_code,final_url=r.url)
    r.raise_for_status()
    p=out/'sources/H41_官方公布目录.html';p.write_bytes(r.content)
    receipt.update(path=str(p.relative_to(root)).replace('\\','/'),bytes=len(r.content),sha256=hashlib.sha256(r.content).hexdigest(),status='SAVED_ORIGINAL')
    soup=BeautifulSoup(r.content,'html.parser')
    print('原目录保存：',len(r.content),'字节')
    print('脚本：',[(x.get('src') or x.get_text()[:150]) for x in soup.find_all('script')])
    for line in r.text.splitlines():
        if any(x in line.lower() for x in ['calendar','release','json','xml','2023.htm']):
            print(line[:450])
except Exception as e:
    receipt.update(status='SOURCE_REQUEST_FAILED',error_type=type(e).__name__,error=str(e)[:1400])
    print('目录请求结果：',json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False))
finally:
    (out/'index_receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
